# Pull Request Notice

---

This repository is a personal hobby fork, not the upstream Breezy Weather project.

If your change is intended for Breezy Weather generally, please open it against upstream instead:
[breezy-weather/breezy-weather](https://github.com/breezy-weather/breezy-weather)

Unless this pull request was explicitly requested by the fork owner, it may be closed without review.

Please check all the boxes that apply:

- [ ] This pull request was explicitly requested by the fork owner
- [ ] I understand unrequested pull requests may be closed without review
- [ ] I was assisted by AI
